speaker: Armorer Kesh
text: The bracket cannon is already charged. Take it and the overflow will stop being immortal.

speaker: Armorer Kesh
text: A session keeps running after you leave. It is not a window you close — it is a room you walk out of. The armory stays active until you kill it.

speaker: Armorer Kesh
text: When you are ready to return, do not collapse the armory. Detach and let the Rift remain here for later.

speaker: Armorer Kesh
text: Walk to the cannon mount and take it. Then come back here when you are ready to go.
